description: Implementation uses project Manrope/pink/beige branding instead of design Plus Jakarta Sans/teal/white system.
Design has a single 56px pill input with absolute teal button; implementation has a raised form container, icon-leading input, and static pink button.
Design sidebar has a non-link h3 title and gray active category; implementation turns title into active pink link and does not render an aside element.
Design shows 9 articles including 4 notable articles; implementation rendered 6 articles at this data state and omits notable section unless extra articles exist.
Header/footer are present but live site content and global theme differ from exported design labels and colors.
